text: TIGHTEN. One trigger: sell next session if V trades under the red bar's low (bar_low), the trend-colour flip exit (C14, C29). The last bar closed red at the pivot, so the exit is armed now; it is not a reason to sell today, and a hold is kept while that low stands. The ADD line stays separate and unchanged: an add only on a close above pivot_high (C30), since structure_shift reads RANGE, no fresh break. The ticket should print both: TIGHTEN on bar_low, ADD on a pivot_high close.
